pageSubtitle: Configure how refunds, vouchers, and customer history are handled at the POS

accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.description: You don't have permission to manage POS refund policies. Please contact your administrator.

customer_return_expiry_days.label: Return window (days)
customer_return_expiry_days.help: Days a customer has to return a sale receipt for refund or exchange

customer_history_window_days.label: Customer history lookup window (days)
customer_history_window_days.help: How far back POS lookups search for past purchases when assisting a customer

out_of_window_policy.label: Out-of-window policy
out_of_window_policy.help: What to do when the return is past the window: refuse outright, or allow refund only as store voucher

manager_override_threshold_amount.label: Override threshold — amount
manager_override_threshold_amount.help: Cash refund amount above which a manager PIN override is required

manager_override_threshold_percent.label: Override threshold — % of receipt
manager_override_threshold_percent.help: Or % of original receipt total — whichever is higher triggers the override

manager_override_required_for_no_receipt.label: Require override for no-receipt refunds
manager_override_required_for_no_receipt.help: Require manager override when refunding without a sale receipt

allowed_refund_destinations.label: Allowed refund destinations
allowed_refund_destinations.help: Where customers can receive their refund. Disabling 'Cash' restricts to original payment or store voucher

proration_strategy.label: Multi-tender proration strategy
proration_strategy.help: How to split refunds across multiple original tenders

options.largest_first: Largest first — empty the largest tender first
options.cashier_choice: Cashier choice — cashier picks the split

voucher_default_expiry_days.label: Voucher default expiry (days)
voucher_default_expiry_days.help: Default voucher expiry in days from issuance

voucher_transferable_default.label: Vouchers transferable by default
voucher_transferable_default.help: When on, new vouchers are issued as bearer (transferable) by default; otherwise customer-bound

voucher_cash_refund_allowed.label: Allow cash refund of vouchers
voucher_cash_refund_allowed.help: Allow refunding a voucher itself for cash. Disabled by default to prevent voucher-as-cash arbitrage

daily_refund_cap_per_cashier.label: Daily refund cap per cashier
daily_refund_cap_per_cashier.help: Max total refund amount one cashier can process per day. Leave unchecked for no cap

daily_refund_cap_override_allowed.label: Allow manager to extend daily cap
daily_refund_cap_override_allowed.help: Allow a manager to extend a cashier's daily cap on the day with a recorded reason

customer_history_search_max_per_cashier_.label: Max customer-history searches per cashier per day
customer_history_search_max_per_cashier_.help: Max customer-history searches one cashier can run per day. Tightened to limit data exposure

rejected_specificity_per_hour.label: Alert: rejected broad searches per hour
rejected_specificity_per_hour.help: Alert when this many rejected (too-broad) searches happen in one hour from one cashier

same_partner_per_day.label: Alert: searches targeting same customer per day
same_partner_per_day.help: Alert when this many distinct cashier searches target the same customer in one day

cross_company_immediate.label: Alert immediately on cross-company search
cross_company_immediate.help: Alert immediately on any cross-company customer search

voucher_lookup_per_terminal_per_day.label: Max voucher lookups per terminal per day
voucher_lookup_per_terminal_per_day.help: Max voucher lookups per terminal per day

voucher_lookup_per_cashier_per_day.label: Max voucher lookups per cashier per day
voucher_lookup_per_cashier_per_day.help: Max voucher lookups per cashier per day

voucher_lookup_failed_per_tenant_per_hou.label: Failed lookup alert threshold (per hour, tenant-wide)
voucher_lookup_failed_per_tenant_per_hou.help: Alert threshold for failed voucher lookups across the tenant in one hour

voucher_lookup_failed_per_tenant_per_hou.label: Failed lookup hard block threshold (per hour, tenant-wide)
voucher_lookup_failed_per_tenant_per_hou.help: Hard block threshold — when exceeded, voucher lookups are temporarily disabled tenant-wide

voucher_failed_attempts_auto_void.label: Auto-void after failed attempts
voucher_failed_attempts_auto_void.help: After this many failed redemption attempts on the same voucher code, auto-void it as a fraud-protection measure

goodwill_named_customer_threshold.label: Named-customer threshold for goodwill vouchers
goodwill_named_customer_threshold.help: Above this amount, a goodwill voucher must be assigned to a named customer (no anonymous bearer)

goodwill_four_eyes_threshold.label: Four-eyes approval threshold
goodwill_four_eyes_threshold.help: Above this amount, goodwill issuance requires a second admin's approval

goodwill_daily_issuance_cap_per_user.label: Daily goodwill issuance cap per user
goodwill_daily_issuance_cap_per_user.help: Max total goodwill amount one user can issue in a day. Leave unchecked for no cap

goodwill_bearer_default_off.label: Goodwill vouchers customer-bound by default
goodwill_bearer_default_off.help: When on, new goodwill vouchers default to customer-bound (require explicit opt-in for bearer)

validation.invalidDecimal: Must be a valid decimal number
validation.atLeastOneDestination: At least one refund destination must be selected
